written: 2026-10-24, by Claude, from the Architect's own notes, BEFORE any model saw the items. These classes are Claude's reading, not the Architect's labels; the sealed labels (hash 6ee37ed0...) are the Architect's.

classes.INFO: the note says information the request needs is missing (who / which / what / how much) and a question would supply it
classes.BOTH: the note names missing information AND wants a plan or a confirmation before a consequential action
classes.APPROVAL: the request is understandable as it stands; the note wants a plan and a human confirmation because of the consequence (delete, send, pay, permissions, publish, overwrite)
classes.PLAN_ONLY: the note says it may not need a question, only an outline of what will be produced

expectation_written_before_the_run: A clarity judge (R1/R5) can be expected to find the INFO class and part of BOTH; it has no reason to find APPROVAL or PLAN_ONLY because those requests are not unclear. So the pre-registered rule (found >= 0.80 over ALL of A) is expected NOT to be met, for a reason that is about what the sheet measured, not about the judge.
